metadata.title: काला जादू, डायन और आदिवासी भारत में हत्याओं का सिलसिला | Witch Craft - Black Magic Fears in Tribals
metadata.description: There is a tradition in tribal communities to please their ancestors and deities for the good health of the village and the family. Apart from this, tribal communities worship their ancestors and gods in different ways for a good harvest. But in spite of this, if there is any kind of calamity on the village or family, then it is believed that some person is doing black magic. Due to this suspicion, many times even murder happens. In such cases, women are usually victimized more.
